destination.title: Flux, geometry and effective theories in string compactifications
destination.question: How do fluxes, internal geometry and localized ingredients determine compactification backgrounds, effective theories and their physical limits?
destination.summary: No original scientific scope statement accompanies the numerical membership, so that membership cannot establish equivalence or uniform assumptions. This proposed family connects background consistency, effective actions, moduli, gauge sectors and control questions while retaining distinct applications and boundary topics.

systems: Supergravity, doubled and worldsheet descriptions where explicitly supplied
targets: Accessible flux sectors and field ranges
regimes: Preserved, partially broken and absent supersymmetry
Spacetime dimension and vacuum curvature retained source by source
assumptions: Membership does not supply a common truncation, supersymmetry condition or control regime
Existence, stabilization, localization and scale separation remain separate tests
conventions: Questions and announced targets are not certified results
Source-object relations retain their supplied structural or source-local status
includes: Explicit alternate homes for fluxless, holographic and geometric boundary questions
The three outside probes as scientifically relevant members
excludes: A universal four-dimensional or N=1 restriction
Automatic identification of supergravity solutions with controlled string vacua
Canonical equivalence inferred from numerical proximity

sources.title: Low Energy Supersymmetry from Non-Geometry

evidence.text: How can a flux compactification retain a brane anomaly-canceling axion while stabilizing the remaining fields and generating a small superpotential without a small perturbative constant?

sources.title: Warped generalized geometry compactifications, effective theories and non-perturbative effects

evidence.text: How can warped type II N=1 compactifications with general SU(3)×SU(3) structure be encoded in four-dimensional supergravity data, and how do instantons or gaugino condensation alter their ten-dimensional supersymmetry conditions and mobile-D3 potentials?

sources.title: On moduli and effective theory of N=1 warped flux compactifications

evidence.text: Can integrable generalized geometry classify closed-string moduli and determine their four-dimensional effective theory in N=1 warped type II flux compactifications without assuming an underlying Calabi–Yau metric?

sources.title: Freedom and Constraints in the K3 Landscape

evidence.text: Which stack multiplicities and flux intersection matrices yield supersymmetric smooth-K3 compactifications, how many inequivalent realizations share those data, and can prescribed gauge groups and matter spectra be constructed directly?

sources.title: Lectures on Generalized Complex Geometry for Physicists

evidence.text: How does generalized complex geometry express supersymmetry conditions for type II flux compactifications and D-brane embeddings, extending the Calabi–Yau description without fluxes?

sources.title: Gravitational Instantons and Fluxes from M/F-theory on Calabi-Yau fourfolds

evidence.text: How do axionic circle fluxes modify the three-dimensional theory obtained from 4D N=1 supergravity, constrain Taub-NUT instanton corrections, and admit an M-theory realization on elliptically fibered Calabi-Yau fourfolds?

sources.title: Gauged Supergravities and the Physics of Extra Dimensions

evidence.text: How can gauged supergravities describe flux compactifications and moduli stabilisation, and when do non-geometric fluxes produce new duality orbits requiring a higher-dimensional description?

sources.title: M-theory Compactifications to Three Dimensions with M2-brane Potentials

evidence.text: Which internal geometries and flux components allow N=2 M-theory compactifications to three dimensions in which a space-filling probe M2-brane experiences a potential, and what geometric restrictions follow when only the potential-inducing flux sector is retained?

sources.title: Consistent Compactification of Double Field Theory on Non-geometric Flux Backgrounds

evidence.text: Can a consistent generalised Scherk–Schwarz reduction construct non-geometric DFT backgrounds with Minkowski vacua, uplift their lower-dimensional solutions, and determine the scalar spectrum and non-Abelian vector gauge structure?

sources.title: A second look at gauged supergravities from fluxes in M-theory

evidence.text: Can genuine M-theory metric fluxes and KK6/KKO6 sources produce full moduli stabilization while retaining an N=4 four-dimensional effective action, and how do its consistency conditions differ from ordinary Scherk–Schwarz reduction?

sources.title: The effective action of warped M-theory reductions with higher-derivative terms - Part II

evidence.text: How do warping, fluxes and higher-derivative corrections determine the scalar potential and N=2 supergravity data of three-dimensional M-theory reductions, including possible no-scale structure and divisor-based complex coordinates?

sources.title: Gauged Supergravities

evidence.text: How are extended supergravities gauged in a duality-covariant embedding-tensor formulation, and how does this construction describe deformations induced by string/M-theory flux compactifications?

sources.title: Leaving the Swampland: Non-geometric fluxes and the Distance Conjecture

evidence.text: Can relaxing an effective flux-quantization assumption give a hierarchical compactification a consistent finite field range? The paper tests this by relating heavy-field freezing diagnostics to two non-geometric flux parameters.

sources.title: F-theory Flux Vacua and Attractor Equations

evidence.text: How are non-supersymmetric flux minima distributed in two explicit no-scale compactifications, and do their on-shell quantities and generalized attractor equations support a correspondence between moduli stabilization and supergravity attractors?

sources.title: Consistent truncation on Calabi-Yau and Nearly-Kähler manifolds

evidence.text: How can IIA reductions on Calabi–Yau and Nearly-Kähler manifolds incorporate fluxes and fermionic condensates, reproduce N=2 supergravity structures, and constrain proposed condensate-supported de Sitter solutions?

sources.title: Compactifications of String/M-Theory and the Swampland

evidence.text: How does flux orientation change supersymmetry while leaving the internal geometry fixed? Freund–Rubin skew-whiffing reverses m, preserves the internal metric and operator spectra, and changes the sign in the Killing-spinor connection.

sources.title: Type IIA on Spin(7) manifolds with fluxes

evidence.text: Can type IIA compactification on compact Spin(7) spaces with fluxes and negative-tension NS-charged defects produce supersymmetric two-dimensional vacua with stabilized propagating scalars and parametric control?

sources.title: Three-dimensional vacua of $G_2$ flux compactifications

evidence.text: Which supersymmetric vacuum relations, physical axion-stabilization conditions, universal scalar dimensions and large-flux limits follow from G2 reduction data without specifying the full scalar-moduli metric?

sources.title: On the vacuum structure of type II string compactifications on Calabi-Yau spaces with H fluxes

evidence.text: Which flux choices and Calabi–Yau degeneration limits admit supersymmetric ground states in four-dimensional Type II compactifications, and can fluxes produce partial N=2→N=1 breaking when the dilaton remains dynamical?

sources.title: M theory compactified on Calabi-Yau fourfolds with background flux

evidence.text: What scalar potential and superpotentials follow from Kaluza–Klein reduction of M-theory on warped Calabi–Yau fourfolds with nonzero four-form flux, and how do they encode supersymmetric ground-state conditions and compare with earlier superpotential proposals?

sources.title: N=3 warped compactifications

evidence.text: Can simple warped orientifolds with three-form flux preserve four-dimensional N=3 supersymmetry, and how far do their massless fields and BPS states determine the local and global moduli-space structure?

sources.title: Supersymmetry breaking and alpha-prime corrections to flux induced potentials

evidence.text: Which flux-induced M-theory vacua break supersymmetry while retaining zero three-dimensional cosmological constant and leading-order stability, and do perturbative α′ corrections destroy the corresponding no-scale structure in Type IIB compactifications?

sources.title: New supersymmetric string compactifications

evidence.text: How can supersymmetric type II compactifications to four-dimensional Minkowski space be constructed on non-Calabi–Yau geometries, and how do NS/RR fluxes and geometric twists enter their supersymmetry constraints and effective superpotential? The paper also examines possible connections to smooth special-holonomy compactifications.

sources.title: BPS action and superpotential for heterotic string compactifications with fluxes

evidence.text: Do supersymmetry conditions plus Bianchi identities suffice for the equations of motion of heterotic flux compactifications at the stated α′ truncation, and what superpotential and radial-modulus constraints follow?

sources.title: General N = 1 supersymmetric flux vacua of (massive) type IIA string theory

evidence.text: What constraints do four-dimensional N=1 supersymmetry and an internal SU(3)-singlet Killing spinor impose on massive type IIA flux compactifications, particularly their geometry, fluxes, dilaton and cosmological constant?

sources.title: Heterotic on half-flat

evidence.text: Can intrinsic geometrical flux generate a Kähler-moduli superpotential in heterotic compactifications, and what four-dimensional N=1 effective action results on the particular half-flat manifolds defined through mirror symmetry with NS-NS flux?

sources.title: Superpotentials in IIA compactifications with general fluxes

evidence.text: How do allowed geometric, NS-NS and R-R fluxes determine the four-dimensional N=1 moduli superpotential through N=4 gaugings, and which combinations yield no-scale vacua or stabilize all seven main moduli?

sources.title: Moduli potentials in type IIa compactifications with RR and NS flux

evidence.text: Can type IIA Calabi–Yau flux compactifications generate computable potentials for all geometric moduli and the dilaton while retaining an N=2 gauged-supergravity description, including accessible quantum corrections?

sources.title: The Scherk-Schwarz mechanism as a flux compactification with internal torsion

evidence.text: Can Scherk–Schwarz dimensional reduction be interpreted as compactification with internal torsion and form fluxes, and can four-dimensional duality representations organize their transformation laws?

sources.title: Type IIA moduli stabilization

evidence.text: Can classical type IIA flux compactifications stabilize all geometric moduli, and admit explicit families with parametrically large volume, weak coupling and a valid four-dimensional description?

sources.title: Low Energy Supersymmetry from Non-Geometry

evidence.text: Combine a world-volume-flux D-term with non-perturbative stabilization, then minimize over charged open fields. A viable uplift requires a surviving positive contribution at the small vacuum-energy scale rather than automatic D-flatness or a Planck-scale energy.

sources.title: Warped generalized geometry compactifications, effective theories and non-perturbative effects

evidence.text: Use a generalized-calibrated BPS domain wall and the RR Bianchi identity to express its tension as a difference of flux pairings. Matching TDW=2|ΔW| determines the on-shell superpotential; holomorphicity motivates its extension to an off-shell functional.

sources.title: On moduli and effective theory of N=1 warped flux compactifications

evidence.text: Tests the cohomological parametrization using BPS D-brane probes. Instanton actions and classical space-filling brane holomorphic couplings have dependence S_inst=S_inst⁰+2πn_a t^a and f=f⁰+2πn_a t^a, with charges determined by twisted classes.

sources.title: Freedom and Constraints in the K3 Landscape

evidence.text: Obtain the tadpole from the integrated heterotic Bianchi identity, and obtain charged matter multiplicities from the Atiyah–Singer index theorem. Evaluate the six-dimensional gravitational anomaly using the resulting spectrum.

sources.title: Lectures on Generalized Complex Geometry for Physicists

evidence.text: G-structure reduction and representation theory organize differential constraints. For SU(3), dω and dΩ decompose into five intrinsic torsion classes W1,…,W5, distinguishing complex, symplectic, Kähler and Calabi–Yau cases.

sources.title: Gravitational Instantons and Fluxes from M/F-theory on Calabi-Yau fourfolds

evidence.text: Use M-theory reduction to Type IIA followed by T-duality: an M5 on the base becomes an NS5 and then Taub-NUT. Resolution-divisor wrappings are related to gauge instanton data through D4-D6-NS5 configurations.

sources.title: Fluxes and gaugings: N=1 effective superpotentials

evidence.text: How can fluxes and Scherk–Schwarz data be translated into N=4 gaugings and then into four-dimensional N=1 superpotentials, with examples of supersymmetry breaking and moduli stabilization?

sources.title: Scales and hierarchies in warped compactifications and brane worlds

evidence.text: How do four-dimensional thresholds in warped brane compactifications depend on geometry versus supersymmetry-breaking dynamics, and can flux compactifications combine a warped hierarchy, heavy bulk fields, and light visible matter?

sources.title: M theory, orientifolds and G - flux

evidence.text: How can background G-flux produce supersymmetric warped M/F-theory vacua, cancel tadpoles, constrain moduli, and yield orientifold descriptions and heterotic compactifications with torsion?

sources.title: Exploring the landscape of (anti-) de Sitter and Minkowski solutions: group manifolds, stability and scale separation

evidence.text: Must geometric ten-dimensional supergravity Minkowski compactifications retain an unstabilized quadratic scalar fluctuation even without supersymmetry?

sources.title: Symmetries and M-theory-like vacua in four dimensions

evidence.text: Can discrete duality and LG symmetries establish critical points in non-geometric flux compactifications despite corrections to the superpotential and Kähler potential, and support isolated supersymmetric Minkowski vacua without relying on heuristic non-renormalization arguments?

sources.title: Non-perturbative vacua for M-theory on G(2) manifolds

evidence.text: Can combined four-form flux and membrane-instanton superpotentials stabilize the geometric and axionic moduli of compact G2 compactifications, including blow-up moduli, and produce supersymmetric or supersymmetry-breaking vacua?

sources.title: The Asymmetric CFT Landscape in D=4,6,8 with Extended Supersymmetry

evidence.text: How are asymmetric simple-current extensions of Gepner models with at least eight right-moving supercharges organized in D=4,6,8, and which massless spectra are compatible with partially supersymmetric Minkowski vacua of gauged supergravity or non-geometric NSNS flux compactifications?

sources.title: Freely acting orbifolds of type IIB string theory on T$^{5}$

evidence.text: Which freely acting type IIB orbifolds yield five-dimensional Minkowski vacua with spontaneous supersymmetry breaking, and what mass quantization, modular invariance, integrality and massless-spectrum constraints govern their Scherk–Schwarz descriptions?

sources.title: A Scan for new N=1 vacua on twisted tori

evidence.text: Which compact six-dimensional nilmanifolds and solvmanifolds support N=1 type II Minkowski flux configurations satisfying supersymmetry and Bianchi identities, and which smeared configurations admit localized completions?

sources.title: No-scale and scale-separated flux vacua from IIA on G2 orientifolds

evidence.text: Can type IIA flux compactification on G₂ orientifolds provide a three-dimensional effective supergravity with no-scale Minkowski vacua and classically stabilized AdS₃ vacua whose KK and AdS scales separate parametrically at weak coupling and large volume?

sources.title: Minimal flux Minkowski classification

evidence.text: How far can supersymmetry determine type IIA Minkowski₄ flux geometries with N = 2 and a minimally realized SU(2) R-symmetry, reducing their classification to PDEs and yielding compactifications with localized sources?

sources.title: Moduli Stabilization with Non‐Geometric Fluxes — Comments on Tadpole Contributions and de‐Sitter Vacua

evidence.text: Can flux changes permit arbitrarily many space-time filling branes, and therefore arbitrarily large gauge rank, while retaining fixed compactification and orientifold data?

sources.title: Towards reduction of type II theories on SU(3) structure manifolds

evidence.text: Which constraints on expansion forms allow type-II reduction on SU(3)-structure manifolds to produce gauged four-dimensional N=2 supergravity, particularly when the forms vary with metric parameters and the reduction becomes base-point independent?

sources.title: Low energy models of string theory

evidence.text: Which compactification geometries and fluxes produce plausible four-dimensional string effective theories, and how do swampland constraints and nonrelativistic strings extend this discussion?

sources.title: Low Energy Supersymmetry from Non-Geometry

evidence.text: Can non-geometric type-II flux compactifications stabilize closed-string moduli at high scales while allowing an exponentially smaller gravitino mass and a compatible brane sector?

sources.title: Quantum Corrections and the de Sitter Swampland Conjecture

evidence.text: Can quantum-corrected flux compactifications support four-dimensional de Sitter geometry while retaining a controlled supergravity description? The supplied analysis studies this through an M-theory background related to type IIB by dimensional reduction and T-duality.

sources.title: M-Theory compactifications on manifolds with G(2) structure

evidence.text: What superpotential follows from M-theory compactification on general G2-structure manifolds, and can weak-G2 deformation data support an explicit four-dimensional N=1 scalar action whose potential agrees with the fermionic reduction?

sources.title: Remarks on the warped deformed conifold

evidence.text: How do properly normalized conifold fluxes reproduce gauge-coupling running, and how can the warped deformed conifold's supersymmetry, chiral symmetry breaking and wrapped-brane dictionary be made explicit? The paper combines review material with several claimed new results.

sources.title: All-orders moduli for type II flux backgrounds

evidence.text: Which bulk moduli survive finite flux in supersymmetric SU(3)-structure type II backgrounds, and can perturbative higher-derivative corrections or nonlinear deformation obstructions further lift them?

sources.title: Supersymmetric Protection and the Swampland

evidence.text: Does a compactification failing the unfluxed instanton screen remain correction-free after worldvolume flux and tadpole-required D3-branes are included?

sources.title: Exploring the Landscape of effective field theories

evidence.text: How can four-dimensional supersymmetric EFTs incorporate fluxes, axions, tadpole constraints and extended objects dynamically, and determine which vacuum transitions remain accessible within a single effective description?

sources.title: Swampland conjectures and infinite flop chains

evidence.text: Does the discrete chamber identification survive additional compactification ingredients? Fluxes and bundles can change both the symmetry and the dynamics, so their transformation across a flop determines whether the unfluxed argument remains applicable.

sources.title: Fine-tuning problems in type IIA string theory

evidence.text: Can one type IIA flux compactification combine a 4-form axion mechanism, KL moduli stabilization and supersymmetry to address strong CP, the cosmological constant and the electroweak hierarchy without fine-tuning?

sources.title: Type 2 theories compactified on Calabi-Yau threefolds in the presence of background fluxes

evidence.text: What bosonic four-dimensional effective theories follow from type II Calabi–Yau compactifications with electric and magnetic fluxes, and under what conditions do gauged N=2 supergravity, symplectic covariance and mirror symmetry survive?

sources.title: On warped string vacuum profiles and cosmologies. Part I. Supersymmetric strings

evidence.text: Which single-coordinate warped vacua of supersymmetric strings and eleven-dimensional supergravity break supersymmetry completely while yielding lower-dimensional Minkowski spaces, and when do fluxes permit finite internal intervals, bounded string coupling, and corresponding cosmologies?

sources.title: M-theory and Type IIA Flux Compactifications

evidence.text: What additional charge sources permit four-dimensional M-theory and conventional type IIA compactifications with internal four-form flux despite supergravity no-go constraints? The paper also assesses a specific massive-IIA proposal for parametrically separated AdS and Kaluza–Klein scales.

sources.title: How many fluxes fit in an EFT?

evidence.text: Which quantized fluxes and membrane-mediated transitions can one four-dimensional EFT describe, and how do supersymmetry, tadpoles, axionic strings and energy scales restrict that set?

sources.title: The Global Gauge Group Structure of F-theory Compactification with U(1)s

evidence.text: Which abelian gauge-field combinations remain massless after turning on a non-abelian-preserving G4 flux?

sources.title: More dual fluxes and moduli fixing

evidence.text: Which additional flux degrees of freedom are suggested by T- and S-duality covariance, what superpotential and consistency conditions do they induce, and can they fix Kähler moduli in supersymmetric Minkowski vacua?

sources.title: A Moduli fixing mechanism in M theory

evidence.text: Can fields localized at singularities stabilize the flux-induced runaway of G2 compactifications, fixing geometric moduli in a controlled four-dimensional vacuum?

sources.title: Three-forms, Supersymmetry and String Compactifications

evidence.text: How can selected superpotential couplings be replaced by four-form integration constants in a manifestly N = 1 supersymmetric formulation, including rigid Polonyi theory and effective theories of Type IIA R-R flux compactifications?

sources.title: Supersymmetric Protection and the Swampland

evidence.text: Can associative-cycle geometry determine whether an N = 1 G2 compactification receives M2 superpotential corrections? The reviewed approach uses rigidity as a proposed substitute for an unavailable complete microscopic zero-mode calculation.

sources.title: Minkowski flux vacua of type II supergravities

evidence.text: Can BPS-like square conditions characterize Minkowski flux compactifications with parallel orientifold sources and suffice to solve all ten-dimensional equations without assuming supersymmetry?

sources.title: From ten to four and back again: How to generalize the geometry

evidence.text: Can warped flux backgrounds be described by four-dimensional supersymmetry data without first identifying a reliable finite set of light fields?

sources.title: Isolated Critical Points for Scherk-Schwarz Compactifications of M-theory

evidence.text: Can surviving U-duality symmetries locate critical points of the nonsupersymmetric Scherk–Schwarz potential in the Planckian interior of moduli space, where the potential cannot be directly calculated?

sources.title: Supergravity and a confining gauge theory: Duality cascades and chi SB resolution of naked singularities

evidence.text: How does the fractional-brane gauge theory explain decreasing five-form flux, and can its infrared strong dynamics resolve the singular conifold background while realizing chiral symmetry breaking and confinement?

sources.title: Aspects of moduli stabilisation in string and M-theory

evidence.text: Can flux compactifications stabilise geometric moduli, and can type IIB conifold transitions dynamically complete rather than trap moduli? The thesis studies the resulting four-dimensional effective theories and their cosmological dynamics.

sources.title: Three-forms in Supergravity and Flux Compactifications

evidence.text: Can N=1 theories with W=eAΦA+mAGAB(Φ)ΦB+Ŵ(Φ) be reformulated supersymmetrically so that the real parameters eA,mA arise from four-form field strengths, with three-forms replacing scalar auxiliary fields?

sources.title: Gauge/Gravity Duality and Warped Resolved Conifold

evidence.text: Construct explicit warped supergravity backgrounds for symmetry-breaking vacua of the conifold gauge theory, especially nonzero resolution VEVs, and identify their operator condensates and infrared limits.

sources.title: New supersymmetric vacua on solvmanifolds

evidence.text: Can compact solvmanifolds support localized supersymmetric Minkowski flux vacua outside the T-duality orbit of geometric torus vacua, and what geometric properties enable these solutions?

sources.title: Gauging the Heisenberg algebra of special quaternionic manifolds

evidence.text: Which abelian and nonabelian gaugings intersecting the Heisenberg isometries of special quaternionic manifolds are consistent in N=2 supergravity, and how do their algebraic constraints relate to half-flat compactifications with NS flux?

sources.title: Fixing all moduli for M-theory on K3xK3

evidence.text: Which supersymmetric flux compactifications of M-theory on K3×K3 are allowed, and under what conditions can fluxes together with M5 instantons generically fix all remaining geometric moduli, including in the F-theory/orientifold limit?

sources.title: Flux Compactifications, Gauge Algebras and De Sitter

evidence.text: Which N=4 gauge algebras actually arise from the considered geometric and nongeometric flux compactifications, and can their flux dictionary realize the gaugings then known to possess de Sitter solutions?

sources.title: R R flux on Calabi-Yau and partial supersymmetry breaking

evidence.text: Can flux on a Calabi–Yau threefold realize the mass deformation that reduces a four-dimensional N=2 gauge theory to N=1, despite restrictions found for compact flux compactifications?

sources.title: Beyond Twisted Tori

evidence.text: Which flux and localized-source combinations define consistent compactifications and effective theories when geometrical flux changes the internal topology? The paper studies this question classically, principally for type-IIA orientifolds with four-dimensional supersymmetry.

sources.title: Lectures on Cosmic Inflation and its Potential Stringy Realizations

evidence.text: Which compactification deformations acquire an energy cost when quantized flux and wrapped branes are included?

sources.title: NonKahler string backgrounds and their five torsion classes

evidence.text: How do the geometric conditions for four-dimensional N=1 heterotic supersymmetry translate into the five SU(3) intrinsic-torsion classes, and can a compact non-Kähler example satisfy both supersymmetry and the H-field Bianchi identity?

sources.title: Supersymmetric sources, integrability and generalized-structure compactifications

evidence.text: Can supersymmetric orientifolds coexist with dynamic SU(3)×SU(3) structures, and under what conditions do supersymmetry and form-field identities imply the source-corrected supergravity equations?

sources.title: Fixing all moduli in a simple f-theory compactification

evidence.text: Can an explicit F-theory/type IIB compactification fix all closed and open string moduli using fluxes, Euclidean D3 instantons and D7 gauge dynamics, while keeping neglected corrections small?

sources.title: Compactifications of type IIB strings to four-dimensions with nontrivial classical potential

evidence.text: How do internal NS-NS and RR three-form expectation values charge the dilaton hypermultiplet in type IIB Calabi–Yau compactification, what classical N = 2 potential follows with electric and magnetic charges, and when can that potential admit supersymmetric or nonsupersymmetric minima?

sources.title: Flat Monodromies and a Moduli Space Size Conjecture

evidence.text: Can supersymmetric three-form flux produce long flat axionic directions, and how do their non-geodesic lengths differ from the size of moduli space accessible to a four-dimensional EFT with fixed cutoff?

sources.title: Modeling General Asymptotic Calabi–Yau Periods

evidence.text: Which four-dimensional observables require exponential period information beyond the polynomial approximation?

sources.title: Warping and supersymmetry breaking

evidence.text: Which gauge theory coupled to N=1 supergravity reproduces the negative-flux throat whose locally preserved supersymmetry is misaligned with the compact orientifold?

sources.title: M-theory on seven-dimensional manifolds with SU(3) structure

evidence.text: How do intrinsic torsion and flux determine the four-dimensional effective theory, preserved supersymmetry and perturbative moduli stabilization for M-theory on seven-manifolds with SU(3) structure?

sources.title: Effective action of (massive) IIA on manifolds with SU(3) structure

evidence.text: Can torsion and scalar-vev-induced fluxes in massive IIA compactifications generate spontaneous N=2→N=1 breaking and stabilize the retained moduli classically, without orientifolds or nonperturbative superpotential terms?

sources.title: M theory on eight manifolds

evidence.text: Can the fivebrane anomaly correction permit compactifications to three-dimensional Minkowski spacetime with nonzero four-form flux and unbroken N=2 supersymmetry, and what restrictions does this impose on the internal geometry and warp factor?

destinations.title: How can a flux compactification retain a brane anomaly-canceling axion while stabilizing the remaining fields and generating a small superpotential without a small perturbative constant?

How can warped type II N=1 compactifications with general SU(3)×SU(3) structure be encoded in four-dimensional supergravity data, and how do instantons or gaugino condensation alter their ten-dimensional supersymmetry conditions and mobile-D3 potentials?

Can integrable generalized geometry classify closed-string moduli and determine their four-dimensional effective theory in N=1 warped type II flux compactifications without assuming an underlying Calabi–Yau metric?
